verdict.summary_en: Boise Semiconductor's order acknowledgement OA26144214 for PO 4500318769 confirms 36,000 Game Card 128 GB – Grand Heist 6 (CMP-GAM-001) at 10.93 USD, confirmed date 2026-11-23. The seller rejects the buyer's DDP Hamburg term and offers EXW Boise only. The goods are packed but on hold until the buyer confirms EXW in writing or names its own forwarder.
red_flags: Seller does not accept 'DDP Hamburg' from the order; it insists on EXW Boise and says DDP is not agreed.
Shipment is on hold at the seller's dock until the buyer confirms EXW Boise in writing or nominates a forwarder, so the confirmed date 2026-11-23 depends on that action.

Internal inconsistency: the terms say EXW, yet also say freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. This adds cost to the buyer's invoice and is not a standard EXW arrangement.
Confirmed date 2026-11-23 is the delivery/ship date as stated; the document does not say whether it is a ship or arrival date.
The document has no issue date.
observations: Clean typed PDF, single page, no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
Item line is the only line (item 00020).
The order date 2026-10-20 appears in the header text.
